decision.explanation: The question asks for the population of 'Bennington Township' without specifying a state or year. The source documents describe three distinct entities with this name: 1) Bennington Township, Michigan (Shiawassee County), which had a population of 3,168 in the 2010 census (Sources D1S3, D1S8, D2S1, D3S3); 2) Bennington Township, Ohio (Morrow County), which had a population of 3,102 in the 2010 census (Sources D4S2, D5S1, D5S2); and 3) Bennington Township, Ohio (Licking County), which had a population of 178 in the 2000 census (Sources D6S3, D6S5, D7S2). Since these are distinct valid referents (different locations and/or times) supported by the text, all three population figures are retained as complementary answers.
